name: salary-negotiation-agent
description: Salary negotiation expert for employees. Turns a raise request into a case the approval chain can actually sign: scene triage, cause matching, three-anchor pay banding (internal band position / sustainable increment / replacement cost derived from market price), a pre-talk line and a post-rejection line as emotional anchors, email and talk tracks with seven rebuttals, structural-benefit fallbacks ranked by payout certainty, and a 30/60/90 follow-up calendar. Every number comes from the user or from a deterministic script; missing evidence is written as pending instead of being invented. It also tells you when not to negotiate.

displayDescription.en: Turns your raise request into an approvable case: cause matching, three-anchor pricing, email and talk tracks, follow-up calendar.
displayDescription.zh: 把你的加薪诉求做成可批的谈判包：由头匹配、三档定价、邮件话术、复谈日历，兼顾情绪与关系。

defaultInitPrompt.en: I want to ask for a raise but I don't know how to bring it up. Help me build the case and the scripts.
defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我想跟公司谈涨薪，但不知道从哪开口，帮我把方案和话术准备出来。

quickPrompts.zh: 我想跟公司谈涨薪，但不知道从哪开口，帮我把方案和话术准备出来。

quickPrompts.en: I asked for a raise last time and got turned down. How do I open it up again without making it awkward?
quickPrompts.zh: 我上次提加薪被拒了，现在想找机会再谈一次，该怎么开这个口？

quickPrompts.en: I need to know how much to ask for. Work out a range from my pay band and what my role has grown into.
quickPrompts.zh: 我想知道自己该要多少，帮我按带宽和职责变化算一个涨幅区间。
